schema_version: v0 — component-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: The pre-build preamble compiled into QUESTION NEXI — standalone typed units for orient, constrain, survey, decompose, triage, hypothesize, validate (roster OPEN by intention: more nexi and more depth per nexus will be found, not planned). A nexus's anatomy: input + feedback + candidate core questions + domain-specific knowledge + core questions + output — WORKED by a mini agentic loop (think -> act -> observe until the nexus's LOCAL exit condition) that actively assembles the output; never a bare lookup (implicit machinery gets missed — this loop is first-class anatomy). Each nexus is THREE STRATA tried in order: (1) DETERMINISTIC FLOOR — ordinary code: parse, index, convention lookup, cache — with TERRITORY measurement COMPOSED from the orient instrument (cairn/orient, the settled owner of prebuild scans), never a parallel scan; (2) TREE WALK — the nexus's own graph tree via the librarian's tools (deposit / nearest / tree_state; its own table through db_domain); (3) CLAUDE CEILING — the loop, depositing back so the stratum boundary moves DOWN over time. Output is typed JSON with PER-FIELD provenance (floor|tree|claude + confidence); the chain's emitted artifact is the BUILD PACKET (intent / constraints / context / sub-problems / known-vs-novel / success-criteria). Two skills are the UI: /chart <something> chains the landed nexi via SCHEMA-GATED HANDOFFS — each stage's prompt is TEMPLATE-FILLED from the previous stage's validated file, so a skipped stage is a build error, not a lapse; /moreabout <something> is the learning door — a SCOPED expansion resolved from the upstream nexus's already-deposited state (a walk, never a re-run), and the invocation itself is a labeled training signal written back to that nexus's tree. Packets are runtime state and berth in instance-space (~/.cairn/devices/chart/); the trees are the durable memory.
why: Akien, verbatim (2026-07-28, the ratifying intent): 'we intend that we can extract debug and grow these specific nexi, knowing we'll find more nexi and more details for each as we go. and the ui shall be /chart <something> --- learning from /moreabout <something>. why: improve the work claude is doing by giving him a more deterministic input.' Sharpened same day: 'so we can inspect and improve what you're getting' — INSPECTABILITY is the load-bearing half: CC's orientation today is invisible reasoning; as a typed packet on disk it can be inspected, diffed, improved. The failure this answers was MEASURED here, not imported: the web-server carrier miss (CC-- 2026-07-28) is premature convergence — proximity to a plausible answer collapsed orient/constrain into pattern-match, bounds-checking never ran to completion. The delivery mechanism follows Akien's observed skill-door facts: CC skips steps when the answer looks visible, plain instructions bypass skills, but /skillname fires reliably — so the preamble lives behind the slash-door as physics, with the handoff schema making each stage unskippable by construction (Law 4). The economics are work-measured: pre-answering the preamble in deterministic code cut build tokens ~89% before caching. AND THE UNIFICATION: 'we'll use the same tools with the librarian. it's agenic loop will just be a simpler form of yours' — the nexi are shared machinery for every Cairn agent, not CC-tooling; one loop shape, two complexity settings.
invoke: /chart <request> — run the chain over a request, emitting the BUILD PACKET a stage at a time. /moreabout <scoped-ref> — expand a too-compressed packet field from deposited state (and teach the tree). Code: `from cairn.chart import ...` per nexus as each lands. Prove: per-stone proofs under cairn/chart/proofs/, sealed by the tester.
node_class: code-seam (cairn/chart/); its skills berth at cairn/skills/chart/ + cairn/skills/moreabout/, symlinked into ~/.claude/skills/ (the standing host-seam pattern). Ticket: CairnCommons/tickets/chart.json; design record: CairnCommons/notes/held-chart-nexus-extraction.json + the imported web-session doc beside it.
entry: FRESH design, converged 2026-07-28 across three same-day sources: the Akien+web-Claude session (the 8-pass preamble, parsimonious typed outputs, more_about, shadow/champion vs Hex, orientation-first), the pattern Akien built at work from these ideas (the BUILD PACKET, ~89% measured), and the Akien+CC design conversation (the mini-agentic-loop delta, the three strata, schema-gated chaining, the home-measured cautions). Nothing grafted from UU. The librarian chain (PROVED 2026-07-27) is nexus #0 — the proof-of-concept of the tree+loop shape every nexus reuses.
state_and_history: compiled to state.json (projected window) + history.json (append-only voyage) beside this charter — the charter-state-history split; this file stays pure intention+why, the operational voyage lives in the sidecars (Law 1/4/7)
filed_edges: (a) STONE PLAN (each cast as a child ticket when fired): orient v0 (floor + exit schema + skill ceiling + instance-space packet berth) -> /chart skill v0 (one-stage chain, grows per landed nexus) -> /moreabout v0 (scoped lookup + signal log) -> tree stratum wiring -> constrain -> survey -> decompose -> triage -> hypothesize -> validate
(b) the ORIENTATION CURTAIN as physics — what orient may READ before constrain/survey commit is a gate, not a promise; an IOU until enforced
(c) ESCALATION DISPATCH (chat loop vs research loop) starts as an explicit verb/prefix (route-is-physics); the escalation nexus accumulates toward a learned dispatcher it EARNS
(d) the FLOOR's staleness story: event-driven invalidation (file-change), never a clock — NO DAEMONS applies to caches

(e) SHADOW/CHAMPION vs Hex: per-nexus scoreboard (champion, match-rate trend, last flip) doubling as the audit trail; promotion = N consecutive DOWNSTREAM behavioral matches (Law 8 for model-swaps); re-shadow event-driven (model-swap, every-Nth-crossing)
(f) the LIBRARIAN drawing chart's nexi with its simpler loop — the unification's first concrete pull, likely the research-loop face (assignment/desk)
gates: per stone: proof gate under the tester (netns seal), VALIDATION persisted beside-code (validations/), committed. The standing live gate for every nexus: proven against the REAL operational agent — CC on real tasks; orient's score is 'did downstream proceed without re-orienting'. THE DIAL is the honesty gate on the whole intention: per nexus, the fraction of output fields filled by floor vs tree vs claude, over time — a nexus whose floor+tree fraction is not growing is not compiling (Law 3 on the 89% claim).
falsifier: RED on any of: (1) a stage output failing the TEMPLATE-FILL TEST — downstream needed an LLM re-read of upstream prose (the interface was shortened, not compiled); (2) a floor answer crossing from WHAT-EXISTS into WHAT-APPLIES (retrieval reports; only the loop above decides — the harbor-exception drift was a floor-match mis-applied); (3) a packet field without provenance, or confidence as hedging prose instead of data; (4) /moreabout answered by re-running the upstream pass; (5) a monolithic packet-builder (nothing piecemeal to score, shadow, or promote); (6) a nexus scored by its own tree's confidence (home-field manufactured resolution — measured at 0.8295 on the librarian); (7) internal reasoning narrowed to match the output's tightness — LOOSE PROCESS, TIGHT OUTPUT are separate concerns, or parsimony squeezes the wide survey that earns its keep.
horizon: re-read when orient v0 has a readable dial from real tasks; when the librarian draws its first shared nexus; when a second consumer (the builder) wants the packet; when Hex is ready to shadow; when /moreabout signals accumulate enough to adjust a parsimony threshold automatically (the tree compiling out a recurring correction, not just logging complaints).
how_it_learns: Learning is this component's SUBJECT, not a sidecar — three mechanisms, all event-driven: (1) DEPOSIT-BACK: every Claude-ceiling assembly deposits into that nexus's tree, so the same question next time is a walk (Law 1 as the runtime loop, inherited from nexus #0); (2) /moreabout AS TRAINING SIGNAL: each scoped expansion is a labeled datum — 'this field, at this compression, wasn't enough for this class' — written back to the upstream tree so the parsimony threshold adjusts per class; (3) THE DIAL: per-nexus floor/tree/claude fractions measured over time, the compilation claim kept honest. Distant: shadow/champion promotion moves a whole nexus from Claude to Hex on downstream behavioral evidence — the withdrawal dial with gates instead of vibes.
traces_to: Law 1 (the preamble compiled; Claude spent on hypothesize/build — the novel)
Law 3 (provenance + confidence as per-field data; the dial; /moreabout frequency — measurements, not vibes)
Law 4 (the schema gate at every handoff — step-skipping made a build error by construction)
Law 6 (each nexus owns its tree and exit schema; the chain composes, opens no side door)
Law 8 (nexus promotion needs downstream proof a home-field-scored build couldn't pass)
the cocoon thread (settle stages around CC — this is its first concrete, gated form)
telos: get Akien out of running the system (an inspectable input pipeline is one he can improve without re-deriving CC's reasoning)
owner: CC owns chart's code + proofs and gates writes to them. Akien owns the design ratification (the intent verbatim 2026-07-28, the naming /chart + /moreabout, the librarian unification). Each nexus's tree is its own table through db_domain's gate (Law 6).
proof: per-stone proofs under cairn/chart/proofs/, each sealed by the tester in a netns; nothing here claims proven yet — cursor at TICKETME, no code, no green. The first teeth land with orient v0: schema gate refuses missing/malformed fields; floor reports only what EXISTS (invented refs refuse); provenance travels per-field; the packet berths in instance-space; an empty request refuses loudly.
